item.title: REA, NBS sign agreement on energy survey to support power sector plans
item.description: THE Rural Electrification Agency (REA) and the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to jointly conduct a comprehensive national energy survey in Nigeria.
